_note: SEARCH ENGINES AND LINK PREVIEWS — the site-wide defaults.
Each page's own title and description live in that page's file, under
`page.seo`. This file only holds the settings that apply everywhere.
`titleTemplate` is how a page title is written in the browser tab. The %s
stands for the page's own title, so "%s · {{brand.name}}" comes out as
`sitemap` is the list handed to Google. Every page should be in it, with a
priority between 0 and 1 saying how important it is relative to the
others. Case study pages are added automatically.
